args.query: Django REST Framework ModelViewSet with token authentication

results.title: Django 6 + Django REST Framework model API with pytest-django
results.summary: A DRF ModelViewSet with a serializer, router and token-free permissions, tested with pytest-django and APIClient on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: DRF ModelViewSet with django-filter range, exact and ordering filters
results.summary: A ModelViewSet with a django-filter FilterSet for price ranges, exact name and ordering, plus page-number pagination, configured in code and tested offline with APIClient on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: Django REST Framework JWT auth with simplejwt, tested offline
results.summary: Obtain and refresh JWT pairs with simplejwt, add custom claims, protect a DRF view, and test expired-token rejection on sqlite in-memory with pytest-django.

results.title: Django post_save signal enqueuing a Celery task, tested with eager mode and on_commit
results.summary: A post_save signal queues a Celery task only after the row commits via transaction.on_commit, then tests run offline on in-memory SQLite with Celery eager mode and pytest-django's on_commit capture.

results.title: Django models with factory_boy and pytest-django db fixtures
results.summary: Django models built with factory_boy DjangoModelFactory (SubFactory, get_or_create, traits) and tested offline on in-memory SQLite with pytest-django database access rules and on_commit capture.

results.title: Django Ninja API with Schema models and pagination on sqlite
results.summary: A typed Django Ninja CRUD API with Schema input and output models, page-number pagination and sqlite, tested offline with the ninja TestClient and pytest-django.

results.title: Koa 3 REST API with @koa/router, Zod validation and supertest
results.summary: A Koa 3 JSON API using @koa/router and @koa/bodyparser with Zod 4 body and param validation mapped to 400 responses by a central error middleware, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: Octokit REST client with MSW: pagination, early stop and errors
results.summary: Test an @octokit/rest client offline with MSW handlers for api.github.com: paginate through Link headers, stop paging early with done(), create issues with auth, and map 404 RequestErrors.

results.title: pyotp TOTP and HOTP codes tested at frozen time
results.summary: Generate RFC-compatible TOTP and HOTP codes, build otpauth provisioning URIs and tolerate one-step clock drift, all pinned to deterministic time with freezegun.

results.title: Hono + Drizzle ORM + SQLite REST API (Vitest)
results.summary: CRUD REST API in Hono backed by Drizzle ORM on better-sqlite3, with Zod validation, tested with Vitest and app.request().
